summary: Tethys AI Crypto Trading App - Performance Testing. Backend APIs working but with slow response times. Command Center page load exceeds 3-second target due to slow /api/trading/kraken/portfolio endpoint (~30s). Tab navigation is fast (<1s). AI Command Center and Spot Trading pages load correctly.

critical.issue: Response time ~30 seconds, causing Command Center to show loading spinner for extended period

minor.issue: Using fallback prices when CoinGecko is rate-limited (expected behavior)

integration_issues.issue: Page shows loading spinner for 30+ seconds due to slow /api/trading/kraken/portfolio API

action_items: Add timeout to Kraken service API calls (currently no timeout set)
Consider caching Kraken portfolio data more aggressively
Add loading skeleton/partial rendering to Command Center while waiting for slow APIs
critical_code_review_comments: ✓ /api/enhanced-ai/status - Returns all model statuses (ensemble, transformer, sentiment, technical)
✓ Tab navigation (Dashboard, $500→$100K, Master Control, Upgrades) - All under 1 second
✓ AI Command Center - Loads and shows AI status, Train All Models button works
✓ Spot Trading page - Loads quickly with order form visible

success_rate.frontend: 70% - Pages load but Command Center delayed by slow API

seed_data_creation: None required - using live Kraken data
context_for_next_testing_agent: The main performance issue is /api/trading/kraken/portfolio taking ~30 seconds. This is caused by the Kraken service not having a timeout set on API calls. The market_data_service has proper timeouts (5s) and fallback prices, but the Kraken service in /app/backend/services/kraken_service.py does not. Once this is fixed, Command Center should load in <3 seconds.

features_tested.AI Command Center: PASS - Loads, Train All Models works
features_tested.Spot Trading page: PASS - Loads quickly with order form

root_cause_analysis.issue: Command Center loads slowly (>30s instead of <3s)
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The /api/trading/kraken/portfolio endpoint takes ~30 seconds because the Kraken service (kraken_service.py) does not have timeouts set on its API calls. When Kraken API is slow, the entire request blocks.
root_cause_analysis.suggested_fix: Add timeout parameter to AsyncClient calls in get_tickers_batch() and other methods, similar to how market_data_service.py handles timeouts
